name: Shake Your Destiny
source:
After a fantastic night out at the summer festival in Numazu, you return to your lodgings with Mia, Lanzhu, Shioriko, and fellow guest Sachiko.

There are so many hot girls in this inn, holy shit! If only you didn’t suck. But the next morning, one of the guests ends up dead.

Who killed the victim? It wasn’t you… was it?

[From [url=https://lithobreakers.itch.io/shake-your-destiny]Itch.io[/url]]
